name: BigBlue
summary: Consumer/prepaid dialup + broadband ISP (bigblue.net.au), a brand of Perth-based Connect West Pty Ltd; became part of the iiNet group by ~2005 (CONNECT WEST PTY LTD, ACN 073 156 779).

events.details: bigblue.net.au online by 2000 (earliest Wayback capture 8 Apr 2000); consumer/prepaid brand of Connect West Pty Ltd (ACN 073 156 779).
Operator Connect West Pty Ltd was acquired by iiNet; BigBlue folded into the iiNet group. Homepage (footer 'Connect West Pty Ltd. ACN 073 156 779') ran through at least late 2005.
ABN 67 623 023 263 (BIGBLUE CONSULTING PTY LTD, active from 23 Nov 2017) is an unrelated later same-name entity, not this ISP.
